body: Create a draft website page on a website the execution operator can administer. Required inputs: website, title, URL slug. The slug uses lowercase words separated by hyphens. The page remains unpublished. Acceptance: reload the page through the selected website, compare title and slug, and confirm it is a draft. Publishing is a separate operation. Executor and verifier: StructuredActions site.page.create.

contract.label: Create website page
acceptance_criteria: The page belongs to the selected website
Saved title and slug match the request

body: Add a registered design section to an existing draft page. The execution operator must administer its website. A preceding create-page step may supply @page.page_id. Choose an installed section kind and provide only its registered content fields. Published pages are rejected. Acceptance: reload the saved section through the specified website and page; compare kind and content exactly and confirm the page remains a draft. Executor and verifier: StructuredActions site.section.add.

contract.label: Add page section

page_id.label: Draft page or previous section output

acceptance_criteria: The section belongs to the selected website and draft page
Section kind and saved content match the request exactly

body: Create a blank Studio production project with the existing Studio project worker. The execution operator requires Studio project creation permission. Supply a project name and optional description. This creates project structure; it does not create media assets or completed scenes. Acceptance: the project name matches and its production and default scene exist with matching project ownership. Executor and verifier: StructuredActions studio.project.create.

contract.label: Create blank Studio project
acceptance_criteria: The project name matches the request
The production belongs to the project
The default scene belongs to that project and production

body: Generate only the reviewed metadata normalization service from ReviewedImplementationTemplateV7a. This is a specific implementation recipe, not a general code author. No user-supplied source or commands are executed. Prerequisites: a separate engineering checkout on the configured non-main branch and the existing authorized GitHub integration for branch writes. Run the template regression checks, commit on that branch, push and verify source hashes against the remote. This procedure does not deploy or merge code. Executor and verifier: StructuredRepository via StructuredActions engineering.service.generate.

contract.label: Build reviewed metadata normalization service
acceptance_criteria: The generated source matches the reviewed template hash
The implementation commit is present on the configured engineering branch; deployment is not claimed

body: Create a movie project using the installed film/proof_of_concept JSON media preset. This creates its production, scenes, editable cameras, lighting and blocking geometry through Studio NativeBlender PresetUse. The user can customize project name, frame rate, frame dimensions, scene duration, lens and aperture through the ticket template. Verify all persisted project, scene and camera values and ownership. This creates a production setup; finished acting, filmed footage and rendered movie delivery are separate work.

contract.label: Build a movie project
acceptance_criteria: Project, production and preset scenes exist under the authorized application
Each scene contains the preset cameras, lighting and blocking geometry
Saved frame rate, dimensions, duration, camera lens and aperture match the customized ticket values
